results.name: Unobstructed walking and chase compositions remain exact without input mutation
Both directions stop before a 35 mm wall even across a 200 m sweep
Camera radius protects near-plane edge grazing instead of just the centre ray
Actual rotated OBB faces block and an empty corner of their AABB stays clear
Pitch and roll quaternions use true local dimensions
Informational yaw does not rotate already computed dynamic AABB dimensions
A chase rise stops beneath overhead beams and downward booms stay above ground
An engulfed anchor escapes its contiguous occupied interval without skipping the next wall
Zero-length and entirely contained booms find a clear surface outside overlapping solids
Broad-phase requests encompass the full boom rather than only its endpoints
Adjacent boxes discovered after contained-anchor recovery cannot capture the camera
Fresh moving and removed blocker poses take effect on the next call
Contained recovery retains neighboring solids instead of oscillating through shared walls
Previous-camera sweep prevents tunneling when the stopped endpoint remains visible from the anchor
Rounding a corner prioritizes a visible inward boom when temporal collision would hide the player
Outward interpolation remains safe at 20, 30, 60 FPS and during a long frame
Malformed positions, bounds and optional state never poison the result with NaN
Production frontage, canopy and building corners protect representative camera booms
